channel.title: Shaping Tomorrow Change Trackers
channel.description: Momentum scans from the Shaping Tomorrow horizon. Each Change Tracker reads across the recent evidence on one topic, labelling the signals beneath it as Accelerating, Stable or Fading, and surfacing the wild cards worth watching.

item.title: Migration inflows reverse as the ageing squeeze turns structural
item.description: Inaugural Change Tracker on Demographics, Migration and Labour Markets. Three wild cards: ultra-low fertility tipping into self-reinforcing decline, embodied AI...

item.title: Reserves and rails are reorganising faster than the rulebooks
item.category: Fragmentation of the Global Financial System
item.description: Inaugural Change Tracker on global financial fragmentation. Eight signals tracked: 5 Accelerating (BRICS Pay/mBridge, Project Agora, gold reserves, panda bonds, regulatory perimeter divergence), 3 Stable (OFAC/REPO Act, FSB/IMF/BIS coordination, dollar reserve share). Two wild cards: kinetic attacks on financial AI infrastructure, AI-Native centres as new bridge category.

item.title: The bar is being reshaped from three directions at once
item.description: Inaugural Change Tracker on Danish law firms for Dreyers Fond. Eight signals: 6 Accelerating (firm-wide AI deployment at Kromann Reumert, EU AI Act compliance, young-lawyer priority shift, international/pan-Nordic firm presence, Bar Council bylaw renewal, legal-tech vendor maturity), 2 Stable (IBA Copenhagen 2026, specialisation/boutique consolidation). Two wild cards: AI Act enforcement event, pan-Nordic merger of a Danish top-five.

item.title: State intervention in critical minerals accelerates as the export-control truce holds
item.description: Inaugural cycle. Government intervention dominates the momentum: US strategic stockpiling, equity stakes, price floors and Section 232 trade remedies are accelerating alongside China's new supply-chain security law, while the acute 2025 export-control weapons sit paused under a US-China truce and minor-metals curbs ease.
